URL-encoded JSON. Root must be `$and`; each entry maps exactly one field to exactly one operator — the grammar is flat and cannot nest.

Example: `{ "$and": [ { "language": { "$eq": "de" } } ] }`

Allowed fields and their operators:
- `value` (string): $eq, $ne, $in, $notIn, $null, $notNull, $contains, $notContains, $startsWith, $endsWith
- `language` (string): $eq, $ne, $in, $notIn, $null, $notNull, $contains, $notContains, $startsWith, $endsWith
- `status` (string): $eq, $ne, $in, $notIn, $null, $notNull, $contains, $notContains, $startsWith, $endsWith
- `aiConfidence` (number): $eq, $ne, $in, $notIn, $null, $notNull, $gte, $lte, $gt, $lt
- `updatedAt` (datetime): $eq, $ne, $in, $notIn, $null, $notNull, $gte, $lte, $gt, $lt
- `key` (string): $eq, $ne, $in, $notIn, $null, $notNull, $contains, $notContains, $startsWith, $endsWith

Limits: at most 32 conditions per request, and at most 200 values in an `$in`/`$notIn` list. Exceeding either is a 400, as is an unknown field or operator.

dryRun.description: Plan files without creating branch/PR (returns file list)

version.description: ISO timestamp of the newest published key, or "empty"

scope.description: Which grid type this view belongs to.

query.description: The stored grid query — the same URL search string the grid page already builds for its filters/sort/search.

body.example: Should this stay formal in German?

mentionedUserIds.description: User ids @mentioned in this comment. Stored for P14-09 to backfill notification delivery — not pushed yet.

keyIds.description: Translation key ids on the current grid page.

expectedVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency (gap 016). When provided, a mismatch against the current Translation.version returns 409 instead of overwriting.

scopeFilter.description: Optional scope filter matching key context scope

alreadyAssigned.description: Already open for this same assignee.

heldByOthers.description: Held by another reviewer and left alone (bulk only).

skipped.description: Not in this project, or no longer pending.

remaining.description: Bulk only: unassigned rows beyond this call’s cap.

assigneeId.description: A project member who can review (tenant admin, or a reviewer on the project).

locale.description: Every pending (draft or review) translation of this locale that nobody holds yet is assigned.

cachedUntil.description: ISO timestamp until the synced namespace stays cached

aiFillMissingLocales.description: AI-translate a target locale missing from Strapi instead of leaving it empty (ADR 0034 bounded sync call). Default off — explicit opt-in, no surprise AI cost.

cached.description: Whether the payload came from the Redis cache

includeEmbeddings.description: Reserved for forward-compat — translation memory embeddings are never actually exported yet (Unsupported vector(768) Prisma type). Accepted/audited only.

secretPrefix.description: First 8 characters of the secret’s random tail, so an admin can match a token in a client config to this row. Null for tokens minted before P7-04 — their plaintext was never stored and cannot be recovered.

windowDays.description: Size of the trailing window, in days.

totalCalls.description: Successful tool invocations in the window.

refusalCount.description: Denied/failed calls + denied resource reads in the window.

spendUsd.description: AI spend attributable to this specific token. Null until AiUsageLog carries a per-token id (see P16-09).

secret.description: Bearer secret — shown once, never again

role.description: Role the token acts as when calling catalog actions.

projectId.description: Restrict the token to one project. Omit for tenant-wide.

actionAllowlist.description: Catalog action ids this token may call. Empty/omitted = every action its role permits.

expiresAt.description: ISO date the token stops working.

secret.description: The new secret. Shown once, exactly like a freshly minted token.

replacesTokenId.description: The token this one replaces. It keeps working until the grace window closes.

previousTokenExpiresAt.description: When the replaced token stops authenticating. Update every client config before this time.
